jobs.title: Business Development Lead - Radio Communications, Radar & Fire-Control Systems
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

Onodrim is building Europe's largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how.

Communications and radar are the areas where we are building real depth – resilient tactical networks, software-defined and commercial-silicon radios, low-cost sensing radar for counter-UAS and platform protection, and the companies that make them. The companies we buy in this space are usually excellent at what they build and under-invested in selling it: a few long-standing customers, a reputation inside a narrow circle, and no one whose job it is to find the next programme. The Business Development Lead for Radio Communications, Radar and Fire-Control Systems changes that. You'll own top-line growth for our portfolio companies in this domain: work out where the demand is, get in front of the people who control it, and bring back signed business.

This is a sales role, and a self-directed one. You'll come with your own view on how to grow the business and the drive to go and test it – with ministries and procurement agencies, signals and air-defence communities, primes and system integrators, and the partners who can open doors. You'll represent Onodrim and its companies externally, at a level where what you say carries weight, and you'll be measured on what you close.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the growth plan.** For each portfolio company in your area, work out where the addressable demand is – tactical-communications and air-defence programmes, platform integrations, border and critical-infrastructure protection, export markets – and write a plan with targets, priorities and a pipeline to get there.
* **Open doors.** Build and work relationships with ministries of defence, procurement agencies, signals and air-defence users, primes, system integrators and partners across Europe; get the company into the conversations and tenders it is currently missing.
* **Own the pipeline.** Qualify opportunities hard, run them through the sales cycle – capture plan, demonstration, proposal, negotiation, contract – and keep an honest, current forecast.
* **Close.** Bring in signed business and be accountable for bookings against the plan.
* **Represent the company.** Speak for Onodrim and its portfolio companies at conferences, industry bodies, customer briefings and trials, with the discretion the sector requires.
* **Shape the offer.** Take what you hear from customers back into product, roadmap, pricing and positioning decisions with the company's leadership; make sure what is sold can be built and fielded.
* **Run proposals and trials.** Lead or coordinate responses to RFIs, RFPs and framework tenders, and the customer demonstrations and field trials that decide them – including the teaming, pricing and compliance work behind them.
* **Work the partner channel.** Build teaming, integration and distribution arrangements with primes, platform makers and complementary suppliers where they get us to customers faster than going direct.
* **Inform what we buy next.** Feed market, customer and competitor intelligence to the deal team and the leadership: where demand is going, which capabilities customers are missing, which companies they wish existed.
* **Build the function.** Put the basics in place – CRM, pipeline reviews, capture process – at companies that have never had them, and help their own teams sell.

  
**Requirements**  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* A degree in engineering, business, economics, international relations or a closely related discipline; an electrical or communications engineering degree is a plus.
* 5+ years in business development, sales or capture management in defence communications, radar, electronic warfare or a closely adjacent field, selling into European ministries, procurement agencies, armed forces, primes or system integrators.
* A track record of closed business you can walk through: what you sold, to whom, for how much, and what you did to win it.
* Working knowledge of how the sector buys – programme and budget cycles, primes and supplier tiers, framework contracts, offsets, qualification, spectrum and export control – and an existing network inside it.
* Enough technical fluency to discuss radios, networks and radar credibly with engineers and military users – waveforms, spectrum, jam resistance, detection performance, integration – and to know when to bring an engineer.
* Self-direction: you have built a pipeline from nothing, set your own targets and hit them without a sales operations team behind you.
* Excellent communication in English, written and spoken – in a proposal, in a boardroom, on a stage – and the judgement to know what not to say.
* Comfort working alongside owner-managers and engineers at small industrial companies, and the ability to bring them with you.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Europe to customers, partners, trials, conferences and portfolio companies.
* Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU, and eligibility for a national security clearance in at least one of our operating countries.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* We operate our business in English; knowledge of a European language other than English is beneficial.
* Military service in a signals, air-defence or electronic-warfare role, or time inside a ministry of defence or procurement agency, that gives you first-hand understanding of the customer.
* An existing national security clearance.
* Experience selling radios, networks, radar or EW sub-systems into primes and platform programmes – the supplier side, not only the system side.
* Experience with NATO, NSPA, EDA or EU-funded defence programmes and their procurement routes, or with counter-UAS and border-security buyers outside the traditional defence channel.
* Experience in a PE-backed

jobs.title: Channel Marketing Specialist/Manager-UK& Ireland
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

UGREEN is looking for an experienced and commercially minded
**Channel Marketing Manager – UK & Ireland**
to support the continued growth of our UK and Ireland business.

This role will have a strong focus on
**retail and channel marketing**
, working closely with the UK Sales team and key retail partners to increase brand visibility, improve in-store and online execution, drive sell-out and support new product launches.

The role will also support selected consumer-facing marketing initiatives to strengthen UGREEN’s brand awareness and consideration in the UK market.

We are looking for someone who understands the UK consumer electronics retail landscape, is comfortable working directly with retailers, and can turn marketing investment into measurable commercial results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute the
  **UK & Ireland channel marketing strategy**
  , aligned with local sales priorities and UGREEN’s global brand direction.
* Work closely with the UK Sales and Key Account teams to develop marketing plans for key retail and distribution partners, including
  **retailer campaigns, product launches, promotional activities and seasonal programmes**
  .
* Build strong working relationships with retail partners and their marketing teams to improve UGREEN’s
  **online and in-store visibility, product positioning and consumer engagement**
  .
* Plan and execute
  **in-store marketing activities**
  , including POS materials, displays, merchandising, product demonstrations and retail activation.
* Manage
  **retailer media and joint marketing programmes**
  , including digital placements, sponsored content, CRM/email campaigns, social media and other retailer-owned media channels.
* Support major UK retail moments such as
  **Black Friday, Christmas, Back to School, Prime Day and key product launches**
  , ensuring strong channel execution.
* Manage channel marketing budgets and MDF, tracking campaign performance and ensuring marketing investment delivers measurable
  **sell-out, traffic, conversion and ROI**
  .
* Work closely with Sales to analyse retailer performance, identify growth opportunities and develop marketing programmes that support
  **incremental revenue and market share growth**
  .
* Support selected
  **consumer marketing activities**
  , including local brand campaigns, PR, influencer/KOL collaborations, partnerships and experiential events.
* Gather UK consumer, competitor and retail insights and provide actionable recommendations to the UK business and HQ teams.
* Collaborate closely with UGREEN’s global Marketing team in China to localise global campaigns while ensuring they are relevant and effective for UK consumers and retail partners.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* **3–5+ years of relevant marketing experience**
  , ideally within Consumer Electronics, Technology, IT, Mobile Accessories, Smart Home or a related consumer category.
* Strong experience in
  **channel marketing, retail marketing or trade marketing**
  within the UK market.
* Good understanding of the UK retail landscape and ideally experience working with major retailers such as
  **Currys, Argos, John Lewis, Amazon, Costco, Tesco or similar national retail accounts**
  .
* Proven experience developing and executing retailer marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional programmes and in-store activations.
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect marketing activities with
  **sales performance and measurable business results**
  .
* Experience managing marketing budgets and evaluating campaign ROI.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple retailers, campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international and multicultural organisation and collaborating closely with global headquarters.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working for a
  **consumer electronics or technology brand**
  in the UK.
* Existing relationships with UK retailer marketing or category teams would be an advantage.
* Experience across both
  **channel/trade marketing and consumer marketing**
  .
* Experience with retailer media platforms, digital marketing, social media, influencer marketing or PR.
* Understanding of both
  **online and offline retail**
  , including e-commerce, physical-store activation and omnichannel campaigns.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Flexible hybrid working model.
* Opportunity to play a key role in building and growing UGREEN’s UK & Ireland business.
* High level of ownership and exposure to major UK retail partners.
* Opportunity to work closely with both the UK leadership team and UGREEN’s global headquarters.
* Career development opportunities within a fast-growing global consumer technology brand.

**Research and Innovation**

LSE Consulting, which sits under the Research and Innovation Division of LSE, provides exceptional support to consulting project activity and ensures the quality of competitive proposals against project specifications, working closely with academics, departments, and research centres across the School.

jobs.title: EUI Product Marketing Manager, Agency
jobs.description:
**What we're looking for**

We are looking for an experienced Product Marketing professional with a strong background in media to lead go-to-market strategy and drive product adoption for the platform’s advertising solutions in Europe. This role sits within the Scaled Growth Team and focuses on accelerating the penetration, product-market fit, and revenue growth of the platform’s ads products through the agency ecosystem.

In this role, you will work closely with agency sales teams, agency partners, and global product stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will be responsible for understanding the agency landscape, identifying opportunities to scale product adoption through agencies, and shaping go-to-market strategies that unlock incremental ads revenue. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, strategic, data-driven, and able to influence cross-functional partners effectively.

To succeed in this role, you should have experience working with media products in a product marketing, strategy, or account management capacity, and bring a strong understanding of agency ecosystems and how agencies drive advertiser growth at scale. This is a full-time position based in London.

**Some of the things you'll do**

* Define and lead the go-to-market strategy for the platform’s evolving advertising products, with a focus on driving adoption, penetration, and revenue growth through agency partners.
* Develop a deep understanding of the agency landscape across Europe, including key partner segments, operating models, and ecosystem dynamics, and translate these insights into scalable growth strategies.
* Benchmark the platform’s agency ecosystem and product adoption against major advertising platforms, identify strategic gaps, and shape initiatives that improve competitiveness and agency-led growth.
* Partner closely with sales, product, marketing, and operations teams to adapt regional product initiatives into scalable, agency-facing solutions that drive adoption and commercial impact.
* Set product strategy priorities for the scaled growth team, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to develop enablement materials, narratives, and activation plans that support execution.
* Leverage data to diagnose growth opportunities, product friction, measurement gaps, workflow inefficiencies, and performance bottlenecks across agency-managed business.
* Translate market feedback and business pain points into clear product, positioning, and go-to-market recommendations that influence product development and improve product-market fit.
* Lead and execute high-impact growth initiatives in partnership with cross-functional teams to unlock incremental advertising revenue and improve long-term product performance.
* Represent the voice of the market internally by synthesizing agency feedback, surfacing ecosystem trends, and acting as a strategic bridge between in-market teams and global product teams.
* Build strong knowledge of the platform’s advertising, commerce, creative, and measurement solutions, and identify how these products can be scaled effectively through agencies to meet customer and business goals.

**Our ideal background**

* Extensive years experience working within media in a Product Marketing, Strategy, Agency or Account Management capacity.
* Extensive knowledge and experience driving product adoption and development across a range of marketing objectives: e-Comm / Performance, Lead Generation, Brand, as well as Creative and Measurement.
* Strong understanding of the agency ecosystem, including how agencies operate, scale client growth, and influence product adoption and media investment decisions.
* Strong knowledge of media sales and marketing processes, and a keen interest in staying on top of industry updates and changes.
* A fast learner with a good sense of judgment and original thinking. Ability to thrive in ambiguity and adjust quickly to change.
* Excellent communication, presentation and analytical skills.
* Customer service orientation and experience working in a client facing capacity
* A commercial mindset with a history of delivering against stretching performance goals.
* Previous experience in agency marketing preferred but not essential.
* BA/BS degree or above or equivalent practical experience.

**How You Will Progress**

Your development is as important to us, as it is to you. You’ll be rewarded for hard work here, with support to get better at what you do. We work in a fast-paced project environment where change is constant. If you’re up for the challenge, you’ll have opportunities to try new things and broaden your skills quickly through exposure to the executive team and new experiences.

We are looking for creative, bold people who embrace ownership and are driven to make a positive impact on the world. If you're excited to collaborate with diverse global teams and lead fast-paced initiatives that make a difference from day one, work with us and challenge yourself to move the world!

Apply now to start your journey to Inspire creativity, enrich life.

jobs.title: Commercial & Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
The role

Slip is more than a receipts platform, and most of the market doesn’t know it. You’ll own how we explain what we do, prove it works, and get it in front of the right accounts. You’ll sit between marketing and sales: building the story and the content, running multi-channel campaigns against named target accounts, and creating the conversations that Tash, our Founder and the commercial team take forward. Your work should show up in the pipeline.

What you’ll own

**Target accounts and campaigns**

* **Target account lists.**
  Build and maintain tiered lists of retailers that fit our ICP across our priority markets, with the right buyers mapped for each.
* **Multi-channel ABM campaigns.**
  Run coordinated email, LinkedIn, events and partner outreach to those accounts, with messaging tailored to each buyer (customer/CRM, retail ops, IT, and the budget holder).
* **Pipeline nurture.**
  Re-engage warm leads and past conversations with content, events and propositions, so no account goes cold.

**Product marketing**

* **Positioning and launches.**
  Turn new feature releases into campaigns with a clear story, demo and video, working closely with product and engineering to know what’s coming next.
* **Customer proof.**
  Get customers to record and publish case studies with real numbers.
* **Content.**
  Create thought-leadership, product and campaign content, including founder-led LinkedIn content for Tash.
* **Proposition consistency.**
  Own how Slip is described everywhere it appears, so a retailer hears the same story on our website, in sales decks, in proposals, at events and in partner materials. In practice this means maintaining the core messaging framework by buyer and use case, keeping the website and sales collateral aligned to it, and flagging when product changes mean the story needs updating.

**Events and partners**

* **Events.**
  Decide which retail and retail-tech events are worth attending or sponsoring, and run them end to end: target-account invitations before, a clear plan for who we meet and what we say on the day, and structured follow-up afterwards. Success is meetings with named accounts, not badge scans.

**Partner marketing.**
Work with our POS, CRM and retail-tech partners on joint activity, including co-hosted events and webinars, co-authored content, and shared introductions to target accounts. You’ll also work with partners to refine how the joint proposition is described, so that Slip and the partner’s story fit together when a retailer hears it from either side.

**First meetings (strong plus)**
Qualify interest, then book and run first conversations, handing well-qualified opportunities to the commercial team. If you do the first three areas well, this follows naturally, and it’s a skill we’ll value in the interview process.

What this role isn’t

High-volume cold outbound, running an agency retainer at scale, or product management. You’ll work with the product team to understand what’s being built and how best to take it to market, but you won’t own the roadmap.

You

* 4-6 years in B2B SaaS marketing, including time at an early-stage startup (seed to Series A)
* Hands-on experience running ABM or multi-channel campaigns against named accounts
* You’ve done product marketing end to end: positioning, launch, and a case study that helped win a deal
* Experience running events and working with partners on joint marketing
* Comfortable on calls with senior buyers, and happy to take a first meeting
* You write well and work hands-on, including video and design tools or the judgment to brief them
* Genuine interest in retail; self-directed, low ego, comfortable in a small team

**Nice to have:**
martech, POS or CRM exposure; experience selling to enterprise buying committees; existing retail network.

**We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else**
🚀
  
  
Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.
  
  
At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.
  
  
We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.
  
  
**The impact is real:**
Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈
**Come and join a mission that matters!**
[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]
  
  
The role ⚡
  
  
📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits
  
  
Joining our newly expanded Marketing Technology & Operations team, you will unlock new capabilities for the Marketing department and CRM team using a suite of best-in-class, no-code/low-code marketing platforms and agentic AI solutions.
  
  

* Act as an independent platforms expert for the Marketing domain collaborating with engineering teams to steer technical solution design and co-work on implementations
* Roll out new platform features and enable adoption by self-service users incorporating them into new campaigns and operational processes
* Use agentic AI tooling to automate structured tasks and remove delivery bottlenecks
* Build and maintain scalable, low-code data pipelines between marketing platforms, data sources and reporting tools
* Monitor and own the health of platforms: identify and mitigate risks, issues or control weaknesses, create accessible documentation, and support views of data and system reliability

What we’re looking for 🌱
  
  
We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.
  
  

* At least 4 years as an administrator/superuser of enterprise-level marketing systems - ideally a marketing automation platform (e.g. Braze, Iterable, Adobe Campaign) or customer data platform (e.g. Twilio Segment, Hightouch)
* Comfort working on or around data integrations in frontend and backend contexts
* Passionate about novel, multi-disciplinary problem-solving - you enjoy working with evolving technologies, bridging domains of expertise, and can demonstrate your success in solving for commercial objectives.
* Experience with operations incorporating AI/agentic workflows, or use of AI agents inside marketing platforms
* Comfort with complex spreadsheets or smartsheets using Excel/G-Sheet formulas
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills and an enthusiasm for collaboration with both technical and non-technical colleagues

**Skills We’d Love To See**

* Familiarity working with real-time data flows and event-driven decision-making in marketing platforms
* Familiarity with common platform integration methods (website tag managers, API authentication, retry/error handling, JSON, webhooks)
* Ability to interpret and edit JavaScript/Python code, and comfort articulating and discussing technical requests to engineers
* Familiarity working with or around “big data”, using tools like AWS Athena, SQL/dbt
* Experience working in the financial sector or another regulated industry

*We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.*
**Why join us? 💜**
We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of
**The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026**
! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!
  
  
**Our Circler Proposition Focuses On Five Areas**

* Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.
* Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.
* Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.
* Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.
* Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.
  
  
**Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!**

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, EU, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Leo Partner Marketing team is looking for a strategic, customer-obsessed Sr. Partner Marketing Manager to lead B2C marketing partnerships in Europe. This role is responsible for developing the strategy and execution of marketing initiatives across retailer, distributor, and other partner channels in the region. A successful candidate will be comfortable with ambiguity and energised by the opportunity to build something from scratch while also delivering tangible results at pace. We are looking for someone who can execute at both a strategic and tactical level, equally at home presenting a channel strategy to senior leadership and managing the workback schedule for an in-store launch across multiple markets.
  
  
You will own the development of B2C partner marketing strategy end-to-end: from building frameworks and processes that do not yet exist, to working hand-in-hand with partners to drive measurable subscriber growth. This is a greenfield opportunity to lead marketing collaboration with strategic partners in on of Amazon’s most ambitious new ventures.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the Leo organisation, including Consumer business leadership, B2B Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Business Development, and regional commercial teams.
  
  
Operating across multiple European markets, you will navigate different regulatory environments, cultural nuances, languages, and retail landscapes. You will build and manage relationships with major international and local retail and distribution partners, adapting global strategies to resonate in each market while maintaining brand consistency.
  
  
This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the indirect partner and channel marketing strategy for Amazon Leo B2C across European markets — building frameworks, processes, and measurement approaches from the ground up.
* Lead senior-level distributor and retailer partner engagements and support quarterly business reviews.
* Work at the strategic level (generating bold and innovative ideas for growth and scale) and at the tactical level (managing marketing campaign execution, planning in-store fixtures, and solving problems).
* Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across Leo, working with Brand, Legal, Finance, and regional commercial teams to unlock partner marketing opportunities and resolve blockers.
* Manage marketing initiatives with retail, distributor, and third-party sales partners, including co-branded campaigns and activations adapted for local markets.
* Own in-store and online retail execution with channel partners, creating best-in-class customer experiences tailored to each market’s retail environment.
* Work closely with agencies across multiple markets to brief, execute, and sign off in-store and digital merchandising collateral, setting workbacks, approving creative, and ensuring compliance with global brand guidelines while allowing for local adaptation.
* Manage simultaneous time-sensitive projects spanning multiple countries, languages, and timezones - driving execution end-to-end in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with competing priorities.

**About The Team**
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organisations operating in locations without reliable, high-speed connectivity.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in marketing
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
* Experience in developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in partner management

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
  
  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Part

jobs.title: Talent & Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Rivan Industries (Rivan.com) is a vertically integrated synthetic fuel company designed to decarbonise industries you can’t electrify. We aim to make synthetic fuel cheaper than fossil fuels and sustain life on earth by keeping the CO2 locked underground.

We’ve recently deployed the UK’s largest synthetic fuel plant and are planning to 1000x this scale in the next 2 years. We now have a clear line of sight to producing synthetic fuels cheaper than fossil fuels over the next 5-10 years, becoming the first company in history to achieve this feat.

We’re looking for a Talent & Partnerships Lead to build the relationships, partnerships and programmes that will bring the world’s best engineers and operators to Rivan and maintain our high talent density as we scale.

**The role**

Build bespoke and invite-only talent networks.

* Systematically enhance and manage Rivan’s network of world-class founders, investors and connectors - spend time on the ground in global talent hotspots to build these relationships in-person.
* Curate, host and attend high-talent density events in the UK and internationally.
* Define the programmes and content that keep our network engaged over time.

**Core skills**

* Have lots of interesting side projects you tinker on, have written about, or are generally curious to work on.

**Bonus skills**

* Have lots of interesting side projects you tinker on, have written about, or are generally curious to work on.

**Specifics**

* £70 - 90k salary depending on experience
* Significant share options as part of the early team
* In-person work at our HQ in Bermondsey, South-East London - flexibility considered based on personal circumstances
* Extensive relocation support, including £6000 per year extra to live close to our HQ
* Health insurance
* Unlimited time-off

*We encourage exceptional applicants from all backgrounds to apply for this role, even if they do not meet all the requirements listed.*

*If you don't see a current role that fits, we also welcome open applications via our website.*

**Interested? Apply at Rivan.com**
